5345.title: Pre-provisioning provider discovery falls back to the primary machine
5345.rootCauseOneLine: New-machine discovery loses target context and probes the primary host, which hides installed-only agents absent there.
5345.proposedFix: Decide and expose a pre-provisioning availability contract, pass new-machine context through discovery, and reconcile against actual host health after connection.
5345.caveats: The real server API omission reproduces twice with controlled host health responses; the custom image, rendered picker and CLI turn were not run. A public-contract/product decision rules out an automatic simple fix.
